q: Can the same imported tonne be declared by two CBAM declarants?
title: One tonne, one CBAM declarant
short: No. Every tonne of imported goods is the responsibility of exactly one authorised CBAM declarant: the person lodging the customs declaration, usually the importer or an indirect customs representative. It must not be reported twice or left out.
audience: Indian exporters selling through EU distributors, agents and customs representatives

ul: Send your data to the party that actually lodges the customs declaration.
If an agent clears goods for several buyers, make sure each shipment's data reaches the right declarant.

p: Each import declaration carries the declarant's CBAM account number, and customs data flows into the CBAM Registry to check declarations.
